status: Conformance vectors for revocation against a time a third party attests in the informational Controller Binding v0 (spec/controller-binding-v0.md §5.2, §10.1). Every key is a test key derived from a public seed; never use one for anything else.

test_keys.note: TEST-ONLY. Each private key is the 32-byte Ed25519 seed SHA-256(seed_label).

producer-a.seed_label: interop-profile-v0 coverage declaration vectors: first producer key

producer-b.seed_label: interop-profile-v0 coverage declaration vectors: second producer key

other-issuer.seed_label: controller-binding-v0 vectors: key that is not the credential issuer

time-attester.seed_label: controller-binding-v0 anchoring vectors: time attester key

requirements.statement: The recorded steps of each selected deal are served under a verified envelope.
The deals shown are every deal of the holder's in the period.
The step is stated by two parties.
